component.name: Accordion
component.description: A vertical list of collapsible sections, each a trigger with a title and a panel that opens independently of the others.

useWhen: A list of content sections where readers need only some, such as a course curriculum, FAQ or settings groups.
Reducing vertical space by hiding detail until requested
The content within each panel is self-contained and does not need to be visible simultaneously

notFor.case: Using Accordion for primary navigation or tabbed content
notFor.because: Accordion is a disclosure pattern, not navigation. Tabs or a nav component are the correct choice when content is mutually exclusive or linked to URLs.
notFor.note: Use a Tabs component or page-level navigation

notFor.case: Placing an Accordion where all items are always open
notFor.because: If the content is always visible, the disclosure mechanism adds interaction cost without benefit.
notFor.note: Use Stack with Heading and Text for always-visible sections

patterns.name: course-module-list
patterns.useWhen: A course page lists its modules, each description opened on demand, and the list needs Show more.
